items.text: Career counselling for PCB students should do more than repeat "aim for NEET." It should help you plan around the pressure honestly, protect a real non-medical route if the result does not go your way, and choose the high-value skill path that gets you to earlier financial freedom either way, not just the one exam outcome.
Whether NEET goes well, needs a repeat attempt, or was never the right fit, PCB still opens more directions than most students are shown, the goal is a plan that works either way.
